build_id.description: Revision the artifact was built from; empty for artifacts older than this field.

os.description: `linux`, `macos` or `windows`; agents recorded before this field are Linux ones.

supports_single_vm.description: Old installed agents remain usable for legacy inventory and deletion.

AgentHostToken.description: The new host and the token its agent connects with. The token is not shown again.

Bucket.description: A registered bucket. Its secret key is stored encrypted and never returned.

ca_pem.description: PEM certificates trusted in addition to the system's, for a private CA.

endpoint.description: `None` for AWS S3, whose endpoint follows from the region.

name.description: Bucket name in the object store.

prefix.description: Key prefix archives go under by default; empty or ending in `/`.

message.description: What was verified: listing, writing and deleting under the prefix.

available.description: False while the service is listed for planning but cannot be deployed yet.

identity.description: `uname -srm` from the remote host. No credential material.

ConnectionTestRequest.description: One authenticated SSH check. Credentials are not stored.

computes.description: Compute VMs beside a control VM (see [`PlanRequest::computes`]).

expires_at.description: UTC Unix seconds. Metadata only in this version; no automatic deletion.

host_id.description:
Registered host that runs the farm: this machine's local host or a remote one.
Required; it is optional only so the error can say how to register one.

snapshot_id.description: Start from this snapshot instead of an empty VM. Its services replace `components`.

Credentials.description: Write-only input. Never include this type in a host/job response or derive Debug.

Datastore.description: One published data store; ports are the host's, not the guest's per-start address.

databases.description: Databases a client can open, excluding MariaDB's own schemas.

credentials.description: Admin credentials; returned only by the explicit endpoints call, never persisted.

datastores.description: Data stores published next to the service APIs, for integrations.

bucket.description: Registered bucket to upload the archive to instead of keeping it on the coordinator.

key.description:
Object key in `bucket`, with `.msb` appended when missing; defaults to `<prefix><id>.msb`.
An existing object is not replaced.

path.description: Absolute archive path on the coordinator; defaults to `<state dir>/exports/<id>.msb`.

index.description: A multi-node compute VM's position, from 1.

ip.description: Live eth0 IPv4 for new all-in-one guests; legacy nodes may retain an overlay address.

faults.description: Faults set on a multi-node farm's links, by VM (`control`, `compute-1`, ...).

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot this farm was restored from.

step.description: Finer progress inside `phase`: our marker or the running Ansible task.

build_id.description: Revision this daemon was built from; a host agent must report the same one.

golden_image.description: msb snapshot new farms start from; the first farm on the host builds it.

golden_image_available.description: This build's golden image is built; otherwise the first farm on the host builds it.

delete_snapshots.description: A purge that also deletes the snapshots this host keeps.

HostKind.description: How the coordinator reaches a host's farm-agent.

Impair.description: Faults the switch adds to the frames from and to a port.

delay_ms.description: Added to frames entering and leaving the port, so a round trip gains twice this.

loss.description: Share of frames dropped in each direction, 0.0 to 1.0; 1.0 isolates the port.

ImportRequest.description: Import from an archive file, or from an object in a registered bucket.

bucket.description: Registered bucket holding the archive; requires `key`.

id.description: Snapshot ID to import as; defaults to the archive's file name.

path.description: Absolute path of a `.msb` archive on the coordinator.

forget.description: A delete that removes only the coordinator's record and leaves any VM on the host.

remote_frames.description: Progress events of the host-side job already recorded here.

remote_job_id.description:
The host-side job a deploy runs as. It outlives the coordinator, which re-attaches
to it after a restart.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot captured by a snapshot job, or restored by a restore job.

NodeSnapshot.description: One VM's disks in a multi-node snapshot.

node.description: The VM it was taken from: `control`, `compute-1`, ...

container_disk_mib.description: Size of each ext4 disk backing Docker and containerd; `None` for nodes without containers.

index.description: Position among the farm's compute nodes, from 1; only multi-node compute nodes have one.

computes.description: Compute VMs beside the control VM; 0 for an all-in-one farm.

disk_mib.description: Includes both container disks for each container host. Sparse disks consume less initially.

computes.description:
Compute VMs beside a control VM, up to 3; 0 runs everything in one all-in-one VM.
A multi-node farm always runs Nova and Neutron.

RegisterAgentHost.description: Register a host whose agent will dial in.

RegisterBucket.description: Register a bucket, or replace a registered one's settings.

endpoint.description:
Origin of an S3-compatible service, such as `https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`
or `http://minio:9000`. Omit for AWS S3.

path_style.description: Defaults to `true` with a custom endpoint and `false` for AWS S3.

region.description: Signing region; defaults to `us-east-1`. R2 uses `auto`.

secret_access_key.description:
Required to register. An update without it keeps the stored key, unless the
endpoint, bucket or access key changes.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint verified by the operator using an independent trusted source.

RegisterLocalHost.description: Register the machine the coordinator runs on as a host.

address.description: SSH address; `localhost` for the local host.

oneOf.description: `None` for the local host, which needs no credential.
Derived from coordinator reservations, not a live hypervisor limit.

connected.description: Whether a dial-in host's agent holds its connection now. Not stored.

port.description: SSH port, user and host key; unused for the local host.

bucket.description: Registered bucket it was uploaded to.

path.description: File path on the coordinator, or `s3://<bucket name>/<key>`.

arch.description: CPU architecture of the frozen guest; its disks cannot boot on another one.

deployed.description: Whether OpenStack was deployed when frozen. Restored farms then start `ready`.

platform.description: Host OS that froze it (`macos`, `linux`); recorded for the operator, not enforced.

reference.description:
msb snapshot reference; set once captured or imported. A multi-node snapshot's is
its control VM's, and `nodes` holds every VM's.

source_exposure.description: Public ports the source farm's catalog was registered with; restores rewrite them.

source_farm.description: Farm the snapshot was frozen from; `None` when imported from an archive.

id.description: Snapshot ID: 1-48 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

SnapshotTransfer.description: An export to, or import from, a bucket in progress.

done_bytes.description: Bytes uploaded or downloaded so far.

total_bytes.description: Archive size; `None` while an export is still writing the archive.
